text:
alex: Heads up — saw a burst of soft_quota hits on /embeddings when clients POST mixed-dim batches. Runtime's size heuristic is recommending splits but split_count spikes p95 latency for those tenants. Example: 100 vectors, dims mix 512/2048, body ~7.8MB.

maya: Can you paste the request headers/shapes? Are they setting any dim header or is this coming from a thin client?

alex: No dim header. Request looked like:
```
Embed-Dims: (none)
Content-Length: 7800000
Body: [ [0.1,...512], [0.2,...2048], ... ]
```
Most SDK users still send raw arrays; our JS SDK doesn't add a dim hint by default for backcompat.

ken: From telemetry side we already emit embed_payload_bytes, embed_split_count, embed_route_decision and embed_softquota_hits per-tenant. We can surface median split_count and p95 downstream latency in console. But we need a deterministic rule for how split decisions map to node counts so the cost estimates aren't misleading.

tia: Proposal: add an opt-in client hint header `X-Embed-Dim-Hint: 512,2048` that SDKs can set. Console gets a toggle "Show split suggestions" (suggest vs force). Rollout via flag `console.split_suggestion.v2` -> canary 10% tenants, then 50%.

alex: Agree on header. Concern: for clients that don't set it, runtime currently parses JSON payload to infer dims which is CPU-heavy on ingress. We should avoid parsing at scale.

ken: Alternative: add a cheap preflight endpoint `/embeddings/preflight` that accepts only meta (dims, count, bytes) and returns a split plan and estimated latency/cost. Lightweight, can be cached in edge. Example response: { "recommend_split": true, "expected_splits": 3, "est_p95_ms": 420, "est_token_cost_units": 12 }

maya: I like preflight. SDKs can call preflight automatically when request size > 2MB or dims heterogeneous. We should add a warning in console when tenants rely on preflight fallback > 10% of the time.

deploy-bot: deploy: starting rollout of feature flag `console.split_suggestion.v2` to 10% tenants (group alpha). See https://go/internal/rollouts/1839

ops-bot: alert: observed 413 fallback increase for group alpha after rollout start. Current alpha 413 rate = 2.1% (baseline 0.3%).

tia: Thanks — can we add these dashboard tiles before widening the canary? Need: preflight success rate, preflight latency p50/p95, fallback-to-413 rate, per-tenant avg_split_count and est_cost variance. Metric names: preflight_success, preflight_latency_ms, embed_413_rate, avg_embed_splits.

maya: I'll add the console tiles and a quick chart with tenant filter. Will also add an annotation for the initial canary window.

alex: I'll open a PR on the JS & Python SDKs to add the dim hint header and automatic preflight call (opt-in). Will include graceful fallback to current behavior if preflight fails.

ken: I'll wire the telemetry dashboard and a regression alert on embed_413_rate > 1% for 5m across canary.

alex: Great — tagging @oncall for visibility. Once dashboard and SDK PRs are up, let's hold expansion until we see preflight success > 95% and embed_413_rate back to baseline.
